Back-half sales guidance was deliberately held flat despite tariff-refund reinvestment and easier comparisons; whether Q3/Q4 comps actually re-accelerate (next print cadence-estimated 2026-11-24) is the unresolved swing factor.

Insider behaviour is one-sided sell: 0 open-market buys against 11 sells (6 insiders, $23.96M) in the last 182 days and no purchase in the 3 years scanned — a genuine counter-signal to the compounding narrative, though the sells are routine in scale and outweighed by the active 7.9% buyback shrinking the share count.

The LTM EBITDA the multiple capitalizes is flattered by a non-recurring item: CIQ's LTM EBITDA $3,657M is $253M below the $3,910M rebuilt from filings because management's Q2 operating profit 'includes approximately $253 million from IEEPA tariff refunds' — and that same ~$0.60 of EPS of tariff refunds sits inside the raised FY27 guide, so a slice of the 'beat-and-raise' runway is a one-time windfall, not durable earning power.

No segment or geographic diversification: single-segment Retail-Apparel, single-geography US, no customer disclosure — the whole thesis is one consolidated comp line, with no breakout to isolate where deceleration is concentrated (an opacity risk).

FCF sign / cash-runway read flagged 'runway not assessable' in survival_capacity even though net-debt/EBITDA is 0.9x — the facts note FCF sign UNKNOWN; opacity on self-funding durability is a bearish-leaning gap to resolve against the heavy capex/IPR&D draw.

Whether the peer discount (EV/EBITDA 6.1x vs 7.6x) is EARNED or RESIDUAL cannot be read off the HETEROGENEOUS peer set (caps span 2203x); the name's margin EXCEEDS and leverage is BELOW the peer median, so the human must judge the justified-vs-overshoot split.

No single gap-down event or catalyst 8-K explains the -24% idiosyncratic drawdown (no drop ≥-10% detected, revised_guidance UNKNOWN) — the market's precise trigger for de-rating is not isolable from the supplied facts.

A genuine counter-point, OUTWEIGHED by the 54% LTM EBITDA margin and 35.5% ROIC: reported FCF is thin relative to earnings — LTM Levered FCF was only $9,343.7M, and even CFO $30,645M less capex $10,984M = $19,661M sits well below $46,489M EBITDA, as heavy capex and an $8,070.0M LTM In-Process R&D charge (which SUBTRACTS from pre-tax income) draw down cash.
